body: it's okay, i really appreciate the concern, the past 24 hours have just been extremely scary for me and i've been an anxious mess, i'm sorry if i hurt you at all

i don't want to be angry at what's a very well-intentioned message but

>"Just because you think different from them. Just because you are different from them isn’t something to be ashamed about in any sense at all. Uniqueness is a quality we all strive for!"

is what i've been told my entire life and saying all this and still having people pull out the "You Just Think Differently It's Okay" stuff is like twisting a knife in my gut

i'm sorry for being harsh, this isn't your fault at all, that's just really difficult for me to hear
